name: listing
assumes: list_designs on a .DSN that opens as an OLE container and whose variant streams read

version is the uint16 major and minor at offset 32 of the root Library stream (path exactly Library), with the values the gate table defines: unknown, older (major below 3), tested (3.2 or 3.3), untested (any other from 3 up)
library is whether the root Library stream is encrypted (a password-protected design: its first 22 bytes are clear, the version is not)
variants is whether the design records CIS BOM variants
listing reads the container without a password, so an encrypted version is never known at listing
